purpose: Acquire and approve exact visual evidence, owned media and clearly labelled illustrations.
hard_gates: Every asset needs exact content identity, rights, provenance, truth role and safe placement intent.
soft_gates: Evidence should be compelling, legible, current and worth interrupting the presenter for.

failure.fallback: Use an approved presenter-only plan or return to visual planning rather than substitute generic decoration.

regression_cases: A changed screenshot hash invalidates every visual descendant.
Generated illustration cannot be presented as factual evidence.
